newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cricket team for West Indies tour announced.
newsitem.headline: Indian cricket team for West Indies tour announced.

text.p: The Board for Control of Cricket in India (BCCI) on Wednesday announced a 16-member squad for a forthcoming cricket tour of the West Indies.
The tour, from February 25 to May 5, includes five test matches and four one-day internationals.
The first Test match starts on March 6 at Jamaica.
The one-day internationals start on April 21, after the conclusion of the fifth test at Guyana.

Team: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Anil Kumble, (vice captain), Navjot Singh Sidhu, Ajay Jadeja, V.V.S. Laxman, Sourav Ganguly, Mohammed Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Robin Singh, Sunil Joshi, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvilla, Dodanarsiah Ganesh, Nayan Mongia, Saba Karim.
